items.title: How Do People Accept Robot in Public Space? A Comparative Study between Germany and Japan
authors: Zhe Zeng, Clara Ayumi Fechner, Fei Yan, Hailong Liu
items.abstract: arXiv:2604.18193v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: With the increasing deployment of robots in public spaces, encounters between robots and incidentally copresent persons (InCoPs) are becoming more frequent. However, InCoPs remain largely underexplored in the literature, particularly from a cross-cultural perspective.
